pages_checked: GitHub REST pulls, state=all, per_page=100, with no author or date filter. Page 1 returned PR #1 and page 2 returned zero.
Reviewed the PR title and body and all four changed-file patches. The files endpoint returned four entries on its first page, matching the PR detail's changed_files count.

exclusions.title: Pin GitHub Actions and enforce immutable references
exclusions.reason: The ci.yml and release.yml diffs only pin action versions. The new action-pinning.yml runs zizmor and filters for unpinned-uses, and dependabot.yml configures dependency updates. The PR body describes manual validation probes, but the patches contain no test-suite repair or change to how application behavior is verified.

limitations: The audit covers GitHub pull requests. The validation probes reported in PR #1 were not independently executed.
